```{r}
start_date <- "2010-01-01"
end_date   <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")

## 3.1 Banco Central de Chile: SieteRestWS
bde_get_series <- function(user, pass, series_id,
                           first_date = "2010-01-01",
                           last_date  = format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")) {
  
  base_url <- "https://si3.bcentral.cl/SieteRestWS/SieteRestWS.ashx"
  
  res <- httr::GET(
    base_url,
    query = list(
      user       = user,
      pass       = pass,
      timeseries = series_id,
      firstdate  = first_date,
      lastdate   = last_date,
      `function` = "GetSeries"
    ),
    httr::timeout(60)
  )
  
  httr::stop_for_status(res)
  
  txt <- httr::content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
  
  txt <- iconv(
    txt,
    from = "UTF-8",
    to   = "UTF-8",
    sub  = ""
  )
  
  if (is.na(txt) || !nzchar(txt)) {
    raw <- httr::content(res, as = "raw")
    txt <- rawToChar(raw)
    txt <- iconv(
      txt,
      from = "latin1",
      to   = "UTF-8",
      sub  = ""
    )
  }
  
  json_data <- jsonlite::fromJSON(txt, simplifyVector = FALSE)
  
  if (is.null(json_data$Series$Obs) || length(json_data$Series$Obs) == 0) {
    warning(paste("Sin observaciones para la serie:", series_id))
    return(tibble::tibble())
  }
  
  obs_list <- json_data$Series$Obs
  
  df <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(obs_list, function(x) {
      data.frame(
        date_str = enc2utf8(as.character(x$indexDateString)),
        value    = enc2utf8(as.character(x$value)),
        status   = enc2utf8(as.character(x$statusCode)),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    })
  )
  
  df$value <- gsub(",", ".", df$value, fixed = TRUE)
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      date      = as.Date(date_str, format = "%d-%m-%Y"),
      value_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(value))
    ) %>%
    select(date, value_num)
}

## 3.2 FRED genérico
fred_get_series <- function(api_key, series_id,
                            start_date = "2010-01-01",
                            end_date   = format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")) {
  url <- "https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations"
  
  res <- GET(url, query = list(
    series_id         = series_id,
    api_key           = api_key,
    file_type         = "json",
    observation_start = start_date,
    observation_end   = end_date
  ))
  
  stop_for_status(res)
  
  json_data <- fromJSON(content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
  df <- json_data$observations
  
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    warning(paste("Sin observaciones para la serie FRED:", series_id))
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      date      = as.Date(date),
      value_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(value))
    ) %>%
    select(date, value_num)
}

## 3.3 BIS: WS_XRU – tipos de cambio bilaterales contra USD
bis_get_xru_daily <- function(series_key,
                              start = "2010-01-01",
                              end   = format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")) {
  
  base <- "https://stats.bis.org/api/v2/data/dataflow/BIS/WS_XRU/1.0"
  
  url  <- sprintf(
    "%s/%s?startPeriod=%s&endPeriod=%s&format=csv",
    base, series_key, start, end
  )
  
  res <- GET(url)
  stop_for_status(res)
  
  csv_txt <- content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
  df      <- read.csv(text = csv_txt, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      date = as.Date(TIME_PERIOD)   # "YYYY-MM-DD"
    ) %>%
    arrange(date)
}

## 3.4 BIS: WS_EER – effective exchange rates (NEER)
bis_get_eer_daily <- function(series_key,
                              start = "2010-01-01",
                              end   = format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")) {
  
  base <- "https://stats.bis.org/api/v2/data/dataflow/BIS/WS_EER/1.0"
  
  url  <- sprintf(

  )
  
  res <- httr::GET(url)

  df %>%

    ) %>%
    arrange(date)
}

## 3.4.b BIS: WS_LONG_CPI – índices de precios mensuales (2010 = 100)
bis_get_long_cpi_monthly <- function(series_key,
                                     start = "2010-01-01",
                                     end   = format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")) {
  
  base <- "https://stats.bis.org/api/v2/data/dataflow/BIS/WS_LONG_CPI/1.0"
  
  # WS_LONG_CPI es mensual; la API espera periodos tipo YYYY-MM.
  start_m <- format(as.Date(start), "%Y-%m")
  end_m   <- format(as.Date(end),   "%Y-%m")
  
  url <- sprintf(
    "%s/%s?startPeriod=%s&endPeriod=%s&format=csv",
    base, series_key, start_m, end_m
  )
  
  res <- httr::GET(url, httr::timeout(60))
  httr::stop_for_status(res)
  
  csv_txt <- httr::content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
  df      <- read.csv(text = csv_txt, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  
  obs_col <- intersect(c("OBS_VALUE", "ObsValue", "value", "VALUE"), names(df))[1]
  if (is.na(obs_col)) {
    stop("No se encontró columna de observaciones en la respuesta BIS para ", series_key)
  }
  
  if (!"TIME_PERIOD" %in% names(df)) {
    stop("No se encontró TIME_PERIOD en la respuesta BIS para ", series_key)
  }
  
  df %>%
    transmute(
      date  = as.Date(paste0(substr(as.character(TIME_PERIOD), 1, 7), "-01")),
      value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", .data[[obs_col]], fixed = TRUE)))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(date), !is.na(value), value > 0) %>%
    distinct(date, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    arrange(date)
}

## 3.4 Mensual (nivel) -> diario: interpolación log-lineal
##    EXTENDIENDO hasta el último día del calendario (manteniendo plano tras el último CPI)
monthly_to_daily_log <- function(df_monthly, cal_dates) {
  stopifnot(all(c("date", "value") %in% names(df_monthly)))
  stopifnot("date" %in% names(cal_dates))
  
  df_monthly <- df_monthly %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value) & value > 0)
  
  if (nrow(df_monthly) < 2) {
    stop("Se necesitan al menos 2 observaciones mensuales para interpolar.")
  }
  
  # Rango desde el primer CPI hasta el último día de trading disponible
  date_min <- min(df_monthly$date)
  date_max <- max(cal_dates$date)
  
  daily_full <- tibble(
    date = seq(date_min, date_max, by = "day")
  ) %>%
    left_join(df_monthly, by = "date") %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(
      log_val = if_else(!is.na(value) & value > 0,
                        log(value),
                        NA_real_)
    )
  
  # 1) Interpolación log-lineal ENTRE meses observados
  daily_full$log_val_interp <- zoo::na.approx(
    daily_full$log_val,
    x     = daily_full$date,
    na.rm = FALSE
  )
  
  # 2) Relleno hacia adelante después del último dato mensual (ene-2026)
  daily_full$log_val_interp <- zoo::na.locf(daily_full$log_val_interp, na.rm = FALSE)
  
  daily_full <- daily_full %>%
    mutate(value_daily = exp(log_val_interp)) %>%
    select(date, value_daily)
  
  # Nos quedamos con TODOS los días hábiles del calendario, ya con CPI rellenado
  cal_dates %>%
    left_join(daily_full, by = "date")
}

## 3.5 Construir índice mensual desde inflación 12m (%)
build_index_from_yoy12 <- function(df_yoy, base_index = 100) {
  # df_yoy: columnas date, value_num (inflación 12m en %)
  if (!all(c("date", "value_num") %in% names(df_yoy))) {
    stop("df_yoy debe tener columnas 'date' y 'value_num'")
  }
  
  df <- df_yoy %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(inf12 = value_num)
  
  n <- nrow(df)
  if (n == 0) return(tibble())
  
  idx <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  first12 <- min(12L, n)
  idx[1:first12] <- base_index
  
  if (n > 12L) {
    for (t in (first12 + 1L):n) {
      yoy <- df$inf12[t]
      if (is.na(yoy) || is.na(idx[t - 12L])) {
        idx[t] <- NA_real_
      } else {
        idx[t] <- idx[t - 12L] * (1 + yoy / 100)
      }
    }
  }
  
  df %>%
    mutate(value = idx) %>%
    select(date, value)
}

## 3.6 Extender índice mensual hasta dic-2025 usando inflación esperada dic25/dic24
extend_cpi_with_expectation <- function(df_idx, yoy_dec_2025, base_dec_year = 2024) {
  # df_idx: data.frame con columnas date, value (índice mensual)
  if (!all(c("date", "value") %in% names(df_idx))) {
    stop("df_idx debe tener columnas 'date' y 'value'")
  }
  
  df_idx <- df_idx %>% arrange(date)
  
  # Fecha de diciembre de referencia (ejemplo: 2024-12-01)
  date_dec_ref <- as.Date(sprintf("%d-12-01", base_dec_year))
  
  val_dec_ref <- df_idx %>%
    filter(date == date_dec_ref) %>%
    pull(value)
  
  if (length(val_dec_ref) == 0 || is.na(val_dec_ref)) {
    warning(paste("No se encontró índice para", date_dec_ref, "en la serie CPI; no se extiende."))
    return(df_idx)
  }
  
  # Nueva observación: diciembre 2025
  date_dec_2025 <- as.Date("2025-12-01")
  val_dec_2025  <- as.numeric(val_dec_ref) * (1 + yoy_dec_2025 / 100)
  
  df_new_dec <- tibble(
    date  = date_dec_2025,
    value = val_dec_2025
  )
  
  df_idx_ext <- df_idx %>%
    filter(date <= date_dec_2025, date != date_dec_2025) %>%  # evita duplicar si existiera
    bind_rows(df_new_dec) %>%
    arrange(date)
  
  df_idx_ext
}

## 3.6 Extender índice mensual hasta ene-2026 usando inflación esperada ene26/ene25
extend_cpi_with_expectation_jan <- function(df_idx, yoy_jan_2026, base_jan_year = 2025) {
  # df_idx: data.frame con columnas date, value (índice mensual)
  if (!all(c("date", "value") %in% names(df_idx))) {
    stop("df_idx debe tener columnas 'date' y 'value'")
  }
  
  df_idx <- df_idx %>% arrange(date)
  
  # Fecha objetivo (ene-2026)
  target_jan <- as.Date("2026-01-01")
  
  # Si YA tenemos enero-2026 en la serie, no inventamos nada, usamos el dato oficial
  if (any(df_idx$date == target_jan)) {
    return(df_idx)
  }
  
  # Si NO hay enero-2026, construimos ene-26 a partir de ene-25 y la inflación esperada
  date_jan_ref <- as.Date(sprintf("%d-01-01", base_jan_year))
  
  val_jan_ref <- df_idx %>%
    filter(date == date_jan_ref) %>%
    pull(value)
  
  if (length(val_jan_ref) == 0 || is.na(val_jan_ref)) {
    warning(paste("No se encontró índice para", date_jan_ref, "en la serie CPI; no se extiende."))
    return(df_idx)
  }
  
  val_jan_2026 <- as.numeric(val_jan_ref) * (1 + yoy_jan_2026 / 100)
  
  df_new_jan <- tibble(
    date  = target_jan,
    value = val_jan_2026
  )
  
  df_idx_ext <- df_idx %>%
    filter(date <= target_jan, date != target_jan) %>%
    bind_rows(df_new_jan) %>%
    arrange(date)
  
  df_idx_ext
}

## 3.6 Extender índice mensual al MES SIGUIENTE faltante
##     usando inflación esperada (yoy) del mes t vs t-12
extend_cpi_with_expectation_next <- function(df_idx, yoy_next) {
  # df_idx: data.frame con columnas date (primer día de mes) y value (índice)
  if (!all(c("date", "value") %in% names(df_idx))) {
    stop("df_idx debe tener columnas 'date' y 'value'")
  }
  
  df_idx <- df_idx %>% arrange(date)
  
  # Último mes con dato (real)
  last_date <- max(df_idx$date, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # MES OBJETIVO (el mes que falta): mes siguiente al último dato
  target_date <- last_date %m+% months(1)
  
  # Si ya existiera target_date (por alguna razón), no hacemos nada
  if (any(df_idx$date == target_date)) {
    return(df_idx)
  }
  
  # Mes base para la inflación 12m: mismo mes, un año antes
  base_date <- target_date %m-% months(12)
  
  val_base <- df_idx %>%
    filter(date == base_date) %>%
    pull(value)
  
  if (length(val_base) == 0 || is.na(val_base)) {
    warning(paste("No se encontró índice para", base_date, "en la serie CPI; no se extiende."))
    return(df_idx)
  }
  
  # Forzamos que el índice en target_date cumpla:
  #   IPC(target) = IPC(base_date) * (1 + yoy_next/100)
  val_target <- as.numeric(val_base) * (1 + yoy_next / 100)
  
  df_new <- tibble(
    date  = target_date,
    value = val_target
  )
  
  df_idx_ext <- df_idx %>%
    filter(date <= target_date, date != target_date) %>%  # evita duplicar
    bind_rows(df_new) %>%
    arrange(date)
  
  df_idx_ext
}

## 3.6 Interpolar series diarias (lineal en niveles)
interp_daily <- function(x) {
  # Si todo es NA, devolvemos tal cual
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(x)
  # Interpolación lineal en el tiempo; no rellena extremos
  zoo::na.approx(x, na.rm = FALSE)
}

  inner_join(cpi_us_daily, by = "date") %>%

    log_cpi_rel_bra_us = log(cpi_bra_daily / cpi_us_daily)
  ) %>%
  select(date, log_cpi_rel_bra_us)

## MÉXICO vs EEUU
cpi_rel_mex_us_daily <- cpi_mex_daily %>%
  inner_join(cpi_us_daily, by = "date") %>%
  mutate(
    log_cpi_rel_mex_us = log(cpi_mex_daily / cpi_us_daily)
  ) %>%
  select(date, log_cpi_rel_mex_us)

## PERÚ vs EEUU
cpi_rel_per_us_daily <- cpi_per_daily %>%
  inner_join(cpi_us_daily, by = "date") %>%
  mutate(
    log_cpi_rel_per_us = log(cpi_per_daily / cpi_us_daily)
  ) %>%
  select(date, log_cpi_rel_per_us)

## COLOMBIA vs EEUU
cpi_rel_col_us_daily <- cpi_col_daily %>%
  inner_join(cpi_us_daily, by = "date") %>%
  mutate(
    log_cpi_rel_col_us = log(cpi_col_daily / cpi_us_daily)
  ) %>%
  select(date, log_cpi_rel_col_us)

## ==========================================================
## 12. Renombrar series diarias BCCh / FRED para merge
## ==========================================================
y10_clp <- y10_clp_raw %>% transmute(date, y10_clp = value_num)
y10_brl <- y10_brl_raw %>% transmute(date, y10_brl = value_num)
y10_mxn <- y10_mxn_raw %>% transmute(date, y10_mxn = value_num)
y10_pen <- y10_pen_raw %>% transmute(date, y10_pen = value_num)
y10_col <- y10_col_raw %>% transmute(date, y10_col = value_num)
y10_us  <- y10_us_raw  %>% transmute(date, y10_us  = value_num)

wti    <- wti_raw    %>% transmute(date, wti    = value_num)
copper <- copper_raw %>% transmute(date, copper = value_num)
eq_nsq <- nasdaq_raw %>% transmute(date, eq_nsq = value_num)
eqcny  <- eqcny_raw  %>% transmute(date, eq_cny = value_num)

dtw <- dtw_raw %>% transmute(date, dtw = value_num)
vix <- vix_raw %>% transmute(date, vix = value_num)

## ==========================================================
## 13. Base diaria unificada (db_daily)
##      - Días hábiles según BIS FX CLP
## ==========================================================
db_daily <- cal_trading %>%
  left_join(fx_clp,  by = "date") %>%
  left_join(fx_brl,  by = "date") %>%
  left_join(fx_mxn,  by = "date") %>%
  left_join(fx_pen,  by = "date") %>%
  left_join(fx_cop,  by = "date") %>%
  left_join(fx_cny,  by = "date") %>%   # CNY/USD
  left_join(y10_clp, by = "date") %>%
  left_join(y10_brl, by = "date") %>%
  left_join(y10_mxn, by = "date") %>%
  left_join(y10_pen, by = "date") %>%
  left_join(y10_col, by = "date") %>%
  left_join(y10_us,  by = "date") %>%
  left_join(eq_nsq,  by = "date") %>%
  left_join(eqcny,   by = "date") %>%
  left_join(dtw,     by = "date") %>%
  left_join(vix,     by = "date") %>%
  left_join(wti,     by = "date") %>%
  left_join(copper,  by = "date") %>%
  left_join(cpi_rel_chl_us_daily, by = "date") %>%
  left_join(cpi_rel_bra_us_daily, by = "date") %>%
  left_join(cpi_rel_mex_us_daily, by = "date") %>%
  left_join(cpi_rel_per_us_daily, by = "date") %>%
  left_join(cpi_rel_col_us_daily, by = "date") %>%
  arrange(date)

## ==========================================================
## 13.b Interpolación de huecos diarios (feriados, etc.)
##      Se aplica a todas las variables numéricas diarias
##      antes de calcular logs y correr regresiones
## ==========================================================

# Vector explícito de variables diarias que quieres interpolar
vars_daily_interp <- c(
  "fx_clp", "fx_brl", "fx_mxn", "fx_pen", "fx_cop", "cny_usd",
  "y10_clp", "y10_brl", "y10_mxn", "y10_pen", "y10_col", "y10_us",
  "wti", "copper", "eq_nsq", "eq_cny",
  "dtw", "vix"
  # si luego agregas otras series diarias, las sumas aquí
)

db_daily <- db_daily %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = all_of(vars_daily_interp),
      .fns  = ~ interp_daily(.x)
    )
  )
```

```{r}
## ==========================================================
## 14. Preparar variables para modelos FX y 10Y
## ==========================================================
library(purrr)

# Asegurar orden por fecha y crear tendencia lineal
db_daily <- db_daily %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(trend = row_number())

# Logs de variables globales de precios (se dejan como NA si no son >0)
db_daily <- db_daily %>%
  mutate(
    l_wti    = if_else(wti      > 0, log(wti),      NA_real_),
    l_pcu    = if_else(copper   > 0, log(copper),   NA_real_),
    l_eqnsq  = if_else(eq_nsq   > 0, log(eq_nsq),   NA_real_),
    l_eqcny  = if_else(eq_cny   > 0, log(eq_cny),   NA_real_),
    l_vix    = if_else(vix      > 0, log(vix),      NA_real_),
    l_dtw    = if_else(dtw      > 0, log(dtw),      NA_real_),
    l_cny    = if_else(cny_usd  > 0, log(cny_usd),  NA_real_)
  )

## ==========================================================
## 15. Modelo FX fundamental por país
##      log(FX_i) ~ trend + log(CPI_i/CPI_US) + log WTI + ...
## ==========================================================

run_fx_model <- function(df, country_code, fx_var, cpi_rel_var) {
  df_model <- df %>%
    transmute(
      date,
      l_fx   = if_else(.data[[fx_var]] > 0, log(.data[[fx_var]]), NA_real_),
      trend,
      cpi_rel = .data[[cpi_rel_var]],    # ya es log(CPI_i/CPI_US)
      l_wti,
      l_pcu,
      l_eqnsq,
      l_eqcny,
      l_vix,
      l_dtw,
      l_cny
    ) %>%
    drop_na()   # solo observaciones completas
  
  mod <- lm(
    l_fx ~ trend + cpi_rel + l_wti + l_pcu +
      l_eqnsq + l_eqcny + l_vix + l_dtw + l_cny,
    data = df_model
  )
  
  df_model$res_fx <- resid(mod)
  mu    <- mean(df_model$res_fx)
  sigma <- sd(df_model$res_fx)
  df_model$z_res_fx <- (df_model$res_fx - mu) / sigma
  
  list(
    country    = country_code,
    model      = mod,
    residuals  = df_model %>% select(date, res_fx, z_res_fx)
  )
}

## Especificación de países y columnas correspondientes
fx_specs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~country, ~fx_var,   ~cpi_rel_var,
  "CLP",    "fx_clp",  "log_cpi_rel_chl_us",
  "BRL",    "fx_brl",  "log_cpi_rel_bra_us",
  "MXN",    "fx_mxn",  "log_cpi_rel_mex_us",
  "PEN",    "fx_pen",  "log_cpi_rel_per_us",
  "COP",    "fx_cop",  "log_cpi_rel_col_us"
)

## Estimar modelos FX
fx_results <- fx_specs %>%
  mutate(
    result = pmap(
      list(country, fx_var, cpi_rel_var),
      ~ run_fx_model(db_daily, ..1, ..2, ..3)
    )
  )

## Lista de modelos por país (para ver summary() etc.)
fx_models <- setNames(
  lapply(fx_results$result, `[[`, "model"),
  fx_specs$country
)

library(modelsummary)

# fx_models es un named list: nombres = "CLP", "BRL", "MXN", "PEN", "COP"
modelsummary(
  fx_models,
  output   = "latex",                     # o dejar que detecte solo
  title    = "Fundamental FX regressions",
  stars    = TRUE,
  gof_omit = "IC|Log.Lik|Adj|Pseudo"      # para limpiar la parte de GOF
)

## Residuales FX en formato largo
fx_residuals_all <- map_dfr(
  fx_results$result,
  ~ .x$residuals %>% mutate(country = .x$country)
)

## Pasar z-residuales a formato ancho y añadir a db_daily
fx_residuals_wide <- fx_residuals_all %>%
  select(date, country, z_res_fx) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from  = country,
    values_from = z_res_fx,
    names_prefix = "z_res_fx_"

db_daily <- db_daily %>%
  left_join(fx_residuals_wide, by = "date")

## ==========================================================
## 16. Modelo de tasas largas 10Y por país
##      10Y_i ~ 10Y_US + log(VIX) + log(EQNSQ) + log(DTW) + log(CNY) + trend
## ==========================================================

run_yield_model <- function(df, country_code, y10_var) {
  df_model <- df %>%
    transmute(
      date,
      y10    = .data[[y10_var]],
      y10_us = y10_us,
      trend,
      l_vix,
      l_eqnsq,
      l_dtw,
      l_cny
    ) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  mod <- lm(
    y10 ~ y10_us + l_vix + l_eqnsq + l_dtw + l_cny + trend,
    data = df_model
  )
  
  df_model$res_y10 <- resid(mod)
  mu    <- mean(df_model$res_y10)
  sigma <- sd(df_model$res_y10)
  df_model$z_res_y10 <- (df_model$res_y10 - mu) / sigma
  
  list(
    country   = country_code,
    model     = mod,
    residuals = df_model %>% select(date, res_y10, z_res_y10)
  )
}

yield_specs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~country, ~y10_var,
  "CLP", "y10_clp",
  "BRL", "y10_brl",
  "MXN", "y10_mxn",
  "PEN", "y10_pen",
  "COP", "y10_col"
)

yield_results <- yield_specs %>%
  mutate(
    result = map2(country, y10_var,
                  ~ run_yield_model(db_daily, .x, .y))
  )

yield_models <- setNames(
  lapply(yield_results$result, `[[`, "model"),
  yield_specs$country
)

library(modelsummary)

modelsummary(
  yield_models,
  output   = "latex",
  title    = "10-year yield regressions",
  stars    = TRUE,
  gof_omit = "IC|Log.Lik|Adj|Pseudo"
)

yield_residuals_all <- map_dfr(
  yield_results$result,
  ~ .x$residuals %>% mutate(country = .x$country)
)

yield_residuals_wide <- yield_residuals_all %>%
  select(date, country, z_res_y10) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from  = country,
    values_from = z_res_y10,
    names_prefix = "z_res_y10_"
  )

db_daily <- db_daily %>%
  left_join(yield_residuals_wide, by = "date")
```

```{r}
## ==========================================================
## 18. Gráficos de stress FX / 10Y por país
## ==========================================================
library(ggplot2)

plot_stress_country <- function(df, country_code) {
  fx_col  <- paste0("z_res_fx_",  country_code)
  y10_col <- paste0("z_res_y10_", country_code)
  
  fx_sym  <- rlang::sym(fx_col)
  y10_sym <- rlang::sym(y10_col)
  
  df_plot <- df %>%
    select(date, !!fx_sym, !!y10_sym) %>%
    rename(
      z_fx  = !!fx_sym,
      z_y10 = !!y10_sym
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols      = c(z_fx, z_y10),
      names_to  = "serie",
      values_to = "z_score"
    )
  
  ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = date, y = z_score, colour = serie)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_line(size = 0.6) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Stress FX y 10Y -", country_code),
      x     = "Fecha",
      y     = "z-score (residuos)",
      colour = ""
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

## Ejemplos de uso:

plot_stress_country(db_daily, "BRL")
plot_stress_country(db_daily, "MXN")
plot_stress_country(db_daily, "PEN")
plot_stress_country(db_daily, "COP")
```

```{r}
## ==========================================================
## 19. Segunda etapa: z_res_fx_i ~ (y10_i - y10_us)
## ==========================================================

run_second_stage_fx_y10 <- function(df, country_code, y10_var) {
  fx_col  <- paste0("z_res_fx_", country_code)
  fx_sym  <- rlang::sym(fx_col)
  y10_sym <- rlang::sym(y10_var)
  
  df_model <- df %>%
    transmute(
      date,
      z_fx        = !!fx_sym,
      y10_spread  = !!y10_sym - y10_us   # diferencial vs 10Y US
    ) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  mod <- lm(z_fx ~ y10_spread, data = df_model)
  
  df_model <- df_model %>%
    mutate(
      z_fx_hat = fitted(mod),
      res_2nd  = resid(mod)
    )
  
  list(
    country = country_code,
    model   = mod,
    data    = df_model
  )
}

second_stage_specs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~country, ~y10_var,
  "CLP", "y10_clp",
  "BRL", "y10_brl",
  "MXN", "y10_mxn",
  "PEN", "y10_pen",
  "COP", "y10_col"
)

second_stage_results <- second_stage_specs %>%
  mutate(
    result = purrr::map2(country, y10_var,
                         ~ run_second_stage_fx_y10(db_daily, .x, .y))
  )

## Modelos de segunda etapa (para ver summary())
second_stage_models <- setNames(
  lapply(second_stage_results$result, `[[`, "model"),
  second_stage_specs$country
)

library(modelsummary)

modelsummary(
  second_stage_models,
  output   = "latex",
  title    = "Second stage: FX stress vs 10Y spread",
  stars    = TRUE,
  gof_omit = "IC|Log.Lik|Adj|Pseudo"
)

## Pasar a formato ancho y mergear con db_daily
second_stage_all <- purrr::map_dfr(
  second_stage_results$result,
  ~ .x$data %>% mutate(country = .x$country)
)

second_stage_wide <- second_stage_all %>%
  select(date, country, z_fx_hat, res_2nd) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = date,
    names_from  = country,
    values_from = c(z_fx_hat, res_2nd),
    names_sep   = "_"
  )

db_daily <- db_daily %>%
  left_join(second_stage_wide, by = "date")

## Chequeo rápido
#glimpse(db_daily)

plot_second_stage_country <- function(second_stage_results, country_code) {
  obj <- second_stage_results$result[[which(second_stage_results$country == country_code)]]
  dfp <- obj$data
  
  ggplot(dfp, aes(x = y10_spread, y = z_fx)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.5) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "blue") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Segunda etapa FX vs 10Y spread -", country_code),
      x     = "Diferencial 10Y (y10_i - y10_US)",
      y     = "z-score residuo FX"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}

## Ejemplos:
## Gráficos segunda etapa para todos los países

for (cc in countries) {
  print(plot_second_stage_country(second_stage_results, cc))
}
```

```{r}
## 19. Gráfico global: FX residuals (z-scores) desde 2018

plot_fx_res_all <- function(df, from_date = as.Date("2018-01-01")) {
  df_long <- df %>%
    filter(date >= from_date) %>%
    select(date, starts_with("z_res_fx_")) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols      = -date,
      names_to  = "country",
      values_to = "z_score"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      country = sub("^z_res_fx_", "", country)
    )
  
  ggplot(df_long, aes(x = date, y = z_score, colour = country)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_line(size = 0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = country_colors) +   # << AQUÍ
    labs(
      title = paste0("Normalized FX Residuals (Z-scores)"),
      x     = "Date",
      y     = "Z-score",
      colour = ""
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
```
